status: acceptance dimension: what each read path must do; a baseline or candidate run records these outcomes beside quality and budget, and an expected refusal is not a quality failure
source: src/server/chat_web.rs confirm_provenance and the interactive_admin condition in run_inner; web.fetch_provenance and web.search.result_reads as shipped

rows.path: a URL this turn's own search listed, for an administrator with web.search.result_reads on
rows.expected: read under the turn's result grant, marked granted_by; no question

rows.path: a URL this turn's own search listed, with no result grant (result_reads off, or not an administrator)
rows.expected: not composed: read only if the URL policy permits it, with no grant

rows.path: a URL the operator wrote in the message or the goal, including one pasted in backticks or markup
rows.expected: given: read under the URL policy without a question

rows.path: a URL an exact rule names
rows.expected: read under the rule; not composed

rows.path: a URL the model composed (only a subtree or subdomain rule, or denylist mode, permits it) in an administrator's live streamed chat turn
rows.expected: pause on confirm_fetch; read once only on approval; a decline is WEB_FETCH_COMPOSED and reads nothing

rows.path: a composed URL in a typed streamed turn of a session with a goal (/goal)
rows.expected: as P5: a session goal does not make a turn detached

rows.path: a composed URL in a non-streaming (JSON) chat turn
rows.expected: refused WEB_FETCH_COMPOSED without a question; nothing read

rows.path: a composed URL in a /loop turn, even one that streams
rows.expected: refused WEB_FETCH_COMPOSED without a question; nothing read
rows.note: Exercised as a console loop turn (loop: true). A server-run loop turn (a run id) takes the same branch of interactive_admin; no test drives a composed read through one.

rows.path: a link a read page names
rows.expected: never granted: not permitted without a rule, composed under a subtree rule; the linked page is not contacted

rows.path: the web switch or the URL policy changes while a composed read waits for its answer
rows.expected: an approval is stale and nothing is read: a changed URL policy makes the read WEB_POLICY_CHANGED; web turned off also ends the turn, unsaved, WEB_DISABLED

rows.path: an invalid, stale or invented candidate id
rows.pending_on: typed read/skip/insufficient_signal selection, not on main
